title: Late-Rush Refund Lateness Share Schedule for Appraisal Orders
content:
**Appraisal Order late-rush refund — lateness share schedule**

The lateness share of the late-rush refund follows the days late: 1 or 2 days late returns 25 percent, 3 to 5 days late returns 50 percent, and 6 days late or more returns 100 percent. The days late are counted in calendar days from the due date of the Appraisal Order. The refund share of the late-rush refund is built on the lateness share, which takes the place of the full share of 100 percent.

| Days late (calendar days after the due date) | Lateness share |
|---|---|
| 1 | 25 percent |
| 2 | 25 percent |
| 3 | 50 percent |
| 4 | 50 percent |
| 5 | 50 percent |
| 6 or more | 100 percent |

**Edges.** Day 2 is the last day of the 25 percent band and day 3 the first of the 50 percent band; day 5 is the last of the 50 percent band and day 6 the first of the 100 percent band.

*Hypothetical readings:* 2 days late gives a lateness share of 25 percent; 4 days late, 50 percent; 6 days late, 100 percent; 30 days late, 100 percent.
